name: Malioboro Run 2026
short_description: Malioboro Run 2026 is a half-marathon held on October 4, 2026, in Yogyakarta, Indonesia, with 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distance options.
ai_summary: Malioboro Run 2026 is a half-marathon event held on October 4, 2026, along Malioboro in Yogyakarta, Indonesia. Organized by Bank BPD DIY, the race offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km.
pros: Route through Yogyakarta's old city, from Jalan Malioboro through the Kraton quarter to Panggung Krapyak
Early starts (half marathon 4.45am) and a three-and-a-half-hour half-marathon cut-off
Course measured and standardised by AIMS, with start corrals for runners chasing a time
Shallow field: tenth place in the 2025 half was 1:40:47 for men and 1:58:59 for women
cons: 2026 entry open only to Indonesian citizens
Places sell out fast: 7,000 went in two days in 2025
Traffic runs beside parts of the course
The 2026 route map had not been published a week before the race

research_highlights: Route passes iconic Yogyakarta landmarks including Jl. Malioboro, Benteng Vredeburg, Titik Nol Kilometer, and (in 2024/2025 editions) heritage areas like Kotabaru and Panggung Krapyak.
Early flag-off times to beat the heat: Half Marathon at 04:45 WIB, 10K at 05:15 WIB, and 5K at 05:30 WIB, with cut-off times of 3h30, 2h30 and 1h30 respectively.
The event has grown rapidly — from about 1,400 participants in an earlier edition to a 7,000-runner target in 2025, with registration selling out within two days.
Since the 2025 edition the course has received route standardisation from AIMS World Running, according to the organiser.
A large share of runners travel from outside the region — organisers reported that 73% of 2025 participants came from outside DIY, reflecting the event's sport-tourism draw.
research_watchouts: Governor Sri Sultan Hamengku Buwono X publicly reminded participants to be careful on the road because vehicles pass on either side of the course during the race.
Registration can sell out quickly (reported as selling out within two days for the 2025 edition), so early sign-up is advised.
The 2026 edition is stated to be open exclusively to Indonesian citizens (WNI), which foreign runners should note before planning to join.

Detailed independent participant race reports (course crowding, heat experience, aid stations) are scarce online; most available accounts are official/organiser and news coverage rather than firsthand runner reviews.

faqs.question: When is Malioboro Run 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: Malioboro Run 2026 is scheduled to take place on October 4, 2026. The event will be held in Yogyakarta, Indonesia, specifically along the well-known Malioboro area. This date marks the running of the race across its available distance categories for participants who have already secured registration.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at Malioboro Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Malioboro Run 2026 offers three distance categories for participants to choose from: a half-marathon distance of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a shorter 5km race. This range of distances allows different types of runners, from casual participants to more experienced racers, to take part in the event.

faqs.question: Who organizes Malioboro Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Malioboro Run 2026 is organized by Bank BPD DIY. The organization is responsible for coordinating the event, which takes place in Yogyakarta, Indonesia, along the Malioboro area, and includes multiple distance categories for participants who registered before the event sold out.
